experiments.scope: poseidon-orchard-r25-prefix-v1 at its own round count; per organizer trial the search of proof.md Section 3 (`search`, unchanged) on the real step program F_kappa: kappa from the coin set of Section 2, walk v -> low 14 bits of OUTSCALE_kappa F_kappa(v) (the low 14 bits of the digest of the line message), parameters fixed in advance (DELTA 6144, n 176, d 16, G 16, S 192, MCAP 96); a returned pair is the two line messages.
